behavioral_effects: hotspots.json commits structural centrality per language view and the centrality-times-invariant-coverage risk join: the rankings surface the real architecture (app.core.config and the rag facade as import hubs, app.api.deps as the top bridge) and the risk table puts rag first - highest-centrality component with an invariant gap (the migration CHECK point of the dimension contract).

Churn-times-centrality is deliberately cache-only, rebuilt by governance scan: a committed churn report would drift on every commit because its input is the history itself. churn_counts also refuses to answer for a directory nested inside another repository, closing the toplevel caveat gitutil already documented.
compatibility_impact: New dependency networkx pinned in the tools lockfile, used for betweenness only - PageRank is implemented in-module by power iteration because networkx 3.x delegates it to scipy, a numeric stack this tool does not need. New generated report with kernel-internal schema.
follow_up: Session 7.3 builds the visualizers over these rankings and un-defers governance visualize.
limitations: Personalized PageRank is implemented and tested but not yet consumed; session 7.3 wires it into the focused views. The site view is not ranked separately - its chains are few enough to read whole in boundaries.json.
reason: Reviews still judge importance by directory intuition: nothing ranks which modules are load-bearing, which bridges hold subsystems together, or which central code lacks invariant coverage, and the phase-6 exit transferred component precision as the open measurement target that ranking is meant to inform; this adds PageRank, betweenness, and centrality-times-coverage risk as advisory, deterministic, committed analysis
risks: PageRank determinism rests on sorted iteration and 4-decimal rounding; a float-ordering surprise on another platform would show up as report drift in CI, which is the detection mechanism working.
rollback: git revert of the single commit; uv sync --project tools/repo_governance restores the environment without networkx.
security_impact: None. Rankings name modules and components; churn reads commit metadata only, never contents.
summary: Add ranking and risk analysis over the joined graph
